segments: A 3-year-old boy was reportedly so good
at soccer that other players' parents
called the police and had him kicked off
the field. The incident happened in
Winter Park, Florida. The boy named
Nevada was playing in a youth soccer
league run by i9 Sports, where most of
his opponents were around 5 years old.
Despite being 2 years younger, Nevada
stood out on the field. He dribbled with
confidence, controlled the ball with
ease, and frequently kept possession,
making it difficult for the other kids
to take the ball away from him.
According to his family, some opposing
parents felt the skill gap was making
the game unfair and could hurt the other
children's confidence. The situation
reportedly escalated to the point where
someone called the police. The league
then issued Nevada's family a notice
banning them from the field and told
them to leave. In the end, the family
had no choice but to walk off the field
with their young son. Nevada's father
was baffled by the decision. In a video,
he questioned whether they were really
being kicked out simply because his son
held onto the ball for too long.
